caption: A person on a unicycle stops abruptly, putting a foot down to maintain balance before continuing.
conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target
physical_dependency_analysis:
OBSERVED: Person on unicycle, one foot down on pavement, bike upright, motion paused. Unknown: Whether balance is maintained, whether motion resumes, whether bike remains upright.

INTERACTION: Foot contact → ground reaction force → center of mass stabilization → balance hold → potential motion resumption.

PERSISTENCE: Upright bike posture sustains balance; foot-ground contact duration determines stability window; rider’s body posture propagates control.

INTERVENTION: If foot lifts prematurely → loss of balance → bike may fall. If foot remains down too long → motion not resumed → static state. Uprightness persists only if center of mass remains within base of support.
